detail: Macron worked as an M&A investment banker at the French Rothschild bank from September 2008, becoming associate-manager (associe-gerant / partner) in December 2010. His best-known deal was advising Nestle on its ~12 billion USD acquisition of Pfizer's infant-nutrition (baby food) division in 2012, for which press reported he earned roughly 2.8-2.9 million euros before tax over 2010-2012.

entity: Fonds de placement dans les PME (captive Rothschild & Cie employee fund)
ownership_stake: 0.5% of the fund's share capital (valued at 61,516 euros in 2017)
detail: In his HATVP declaration of interests of 16 March 2017 (filed for his presidential candidacy), Macron declared holding 0.5% of a captive PME (small-and-medium enterprise) investment fund offered to Rothschild & Cie employees, which he subscribed to in March 2012, valued at 61,516 euros. The HATVP reviewed his declarations and found no element calling into question their sincerity.

entity: En Marche! (later La Republique En Marche, then Renaissance)
ownership_stake: n/a (political association/party, not a commercial entity)
detail: Macron founded the political movement En Marche! on 6 April 2016 in Amiens and served as its president until shortly after his May 2017 election, when Catherine Barbaroux succeeded him. It is a political organisation (declared as an association, EMA En Marche) rather than a commercial company.

entity: Inspection generale des finances (French civil service corps)
detail: After graduating from the ENA in 2004, Macron joined the Inspection generale des finances as a finance inspector (inspecteur des finances), the senior state-audit corps. He took leave from the corps to join Rothschild in 2008. This is public-sector employment, listed for completeness of professional affiliations.

entity: Commission pour la liberation de la croissance francaise ("Commission Attali")
detail: Macron served as deputy general rapporteur (rapporteur general adjoint) of the Attali Commission set up by President Sarkozy to recommend pro-growth reforms; it reported in January 2008. An advisory public role, listed for completeness.

entity: HATVP declaration of patrimonial situation / interests (Haute Autorite pour la transparence de la vie publique)
period: Declarations filed 2017 and 2022 (2022 published JORF 28 April 2022)
detail: Per his HATVP/Legifrance declarations, Macron declared no real estate (no full ownership, usufruct, or SCI shares) and no vehicles/boats above 10,000 euros; his declared patrimony (around half a million euros) consisted chiefly of bank accounts and financial savings products (e.g. a Livret de developpement durable, Livret A, and life insurance). This entry records the absence of company directorships or material corporate holdings as of those declarations.
